hints.title: Unique Character Substrings
hints.text: Substrings cannot contain any repeated characters.

hints.title: Dynamic Window Bounds
hints.text: Expand the right pointer and shrink the left pointer whenever a character frequency exceeds one.

hints.title: Span Contribution
hints.text: For each valid right endpoint, the span length between endpoints contributes directly to the count of valid substrings.

hints.title: Sliding Window Counter
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def numberOfSpecialSubstrings(self, s: str) -> int:
        cnt = [0] * 26
        ans = 0
        j = 0
        for i, char in enumerate(s):
            idx = ord(char) - ord('a')
            cnt[idx] += 1
            while cnt[idx] > 1:
                cnt[ord(s[j]) - ord('a')] -= 1
                j += 1
            ans += (i - j + 1)
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Both pointers move monotonically forward with 26-element frequency tracking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all substrings takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed alphabet frequency array uses constant memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes sliding window length property for counting distinct substrings.
